project_type: Browser-based single-player 3D game (three.js), static site with no build step
build_system: None. No bundler. Plain ES modules loaded via <script type="module"> and an import map. npm/npx are NOT usable (no external registry access, and a proxy-bootstrap preload breaks npm). Do NOT introduce a build step.
test_framework: No unit-test framework installed. Verification is done by (1) Node syntax check `node --check <file.js>` on every JS module, and (2) headless browser smoke test with agent-browser reading window-exposed state and console errors.
build_command: None (static site). Optionally `for f in $(find js -name '*.js'); do node --check "$f"; done` to syntax-check all modules.
test_command: cd /projects/sandbox/Games && python3 -m http.server 8099 >/tmp/httpd.log 2>&1 & SRV=$!; sleep 2; agent-browser --session verify open "http://localhost:8099/index.html"; agent-browser --session verify wait 3000; agent-browser --session verify eval "JSON.stringify(window.__GAME__ ? window.__GAME__.debugState() : 'no game')"; agent-browser --session verify eval "(window.__consoleErrors||[]).join(' | ') || 'NO_ERRORS'"; kill $SRV
verification_instructions: Serve the folder with `python3 -m http.server 8099` and load http://localhost:8099/index.html in agent-browser (headless, --session <name>). The game MUST expose a global `window.__GAME__` with a `debugState()` method returning JSON (state name, health, ammo, current weapon, objective id, zombie count, current zone). It MUST also capture uncaught errors and console.error calls into `window.__consoleErrors` (array). A passing run: THREE loads (window.__GAME__ exists), debugState() returns a valid object, and window.__consoleErrors is empty after load and after simulating a few actions via eval. Take a screenshot to /projects/sandbox/.kiro/artifacts/screenshots/ for evidence.
setup_instructions: No install needed. three.js r160 is ALREADY vendored at vendor/three/ (build/three.module.js, build/three.module.min.js, examples/jsm/controls/PointerLockControls.js, LICENSE). Runtimes available: node v22.23.3 (for `node --check` only), python3 3.9 (for http.server), agent-browser CLI (headless chromium for verification).
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network: NO external internet. No CDN, no npm registry, no asset downloads. All assets MUST be procedurally generated in code (three.js primitive geometry, CanvasTexture drawn on <canvas>, Web Audio API oscillators/noise for sound). three.js is vendored and committed; load it via an import map ({"three":"./vendor/three/build/three.module.js","three/addons/":"./vendor/three/examples/jsm/"}). PointerLockControls imports the bare specifier 'three', so the import map is REQUIRED. Background processes do NOT persist across separate shell tool calls, so any serve+verify must run in ONE chained command.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md (fresh empty repo). Work on branch feat/zombie-apocalypse-3js-game (already created). Do NOT push or open PRs. Commit each feature when complete. Vendor directory vendor/three/ must be committed (it is the offline runtime).
key_patterns: ES module per system (Game, Player, Weapons, Zombie, NPC, Zone/World, HUD, Audio, Input, AssetFactory). Import map in index.html. Game loop via requestAnimationFrame with fixed-ish delta. FPS/third-person controls via PointerLockControls. Expose window.__GAME__ for headless testing. Capture errors into window.__consoleErrors. Procedural asset factory creates all meshes/textures/sounds so real downloaded assets can be swapped in later behind the same factory API.
relevant_files: index.html (entry, import map, canvas, HUD overlay, start/win/lose screens)
vendor/three/build/three.module.js (vendored engine - already present, do not modify)
js/main.js (bootstrap: create Game, expose window.__GAME__, error capture)
js/core/Game.js (state machine, loop, zone management, win/lose)
js/entities/Weapon.js (knife melee + gun ranged, ammo, progression)
js/entities/NPC.js (friendly + hostile, dialogue, quest hooks, killable)
js/world/Zone.js (base zone: terrain, buildings, spawns, exits)
js/world/zones/MedicalFacility.js (second travel zone: deliver cure, finale)
directory_structure: Repo root /projects/sandbox/Games. vendor/three (committed offline engine). index.html at root. js/ split into core/, assets/, entities/, world/ (+ world/zones/), ui/, quest/. css/ for styles. README.md at root. .agents/tasks/ holds this plan.
